name: off-the-wall
description: Quotes your own past corrections back to the agent before it answers, reports how often you had to correct it, and makes the orchestrator name a model for every subagent. Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Stop repeating the same correction to your agent
interface.longDescription: Keeps the messages where you corrected your coding agent and quotes the most relevant ones back, word for word, before each answer. `otw report` shows what you correct most from the history already on your machine, and subagent routing makes the orchestrator name a cheaper model for each subagent. No API key; judging runs through the codex or claude CLI you already use, and everything stays in ~/.otw.
